name: drawer
behavior: APG dialog (modal) pattern, edge-anchored (focus trapped in panel; Esc closes; focus returns to trigger; aria-modal=true; bottom-edge drawers may add drag-to-dismiss — pointer enhancement only, keyboard dismissal stays Esc)

parts.note: per-corner rule (semantic.md §4): radius value comes from radius-overlay; only the corners opposite the anchored edge are rounded (edge:bottom → top corners, edge:start → end corners). Logical edge names survive RTL.
drag affordance; conventionally present only when edge:bottom
carries title (type-heading-3) and optional description (type-body, content-secondary)

anatomyNotes: shadcn splits sheet (side panel) from drawer (bottom, vaul); Salt Drawer covers all four positions — one anatomy here, the edge axis is the whole difference. Size binds to size-overlay-* along the panel's anchored-edge-normal dimension.
